findings.detail: guaranteed-slot-firer invoked chef-eod at 2026-08-24T08:47:24Z (bounded 1800s, still in flight at 08:52Z, no exit line) while cowork-match-slots.js ALSO matched chef-eod into this tick's slots[] with the identical trigger_prompt. Two independent dispatch mechanisms selected the same guaranteed slot in the same window. Dispatcher SUPPRESSED its own chef-eod spawn. Rationale: the published-marker gate is agent-side and its Phase-2 claim sits immediately before send_telegram, so a chef 3min into its pipeline holds nothing (live probe: no published:chef-eod:2026-08-24 among held cowork-slot locks) — a second spawn passes Phase 1, runs a full duplicate pipeline, and races. Phase 2 would prevent double-PUBLISH but does NOT cover docs/agent-memory/notebooks/unified-agent.md or docs/data/unified-agent-synthesis-<DATE>-<SLOT>.json, which are unguarded concurrent writes. This is the c132/c132-peer double-section shape that already landed 2026-08-22.

The standing 'chef-eod silent 11 days' premise rested on cowork-schedule.json .last_fired=2026-08-13T08:55:52Z. FALSIFIED by the firer log: chef-eod was invoked 2026-08-14T08:59:14Z (exit_code=0), 2026-08-18T08:51:18Z (exit_code=1), and 2026-08-24T08:47:24Z. last_fired is written ONLY by cowork-team Step 5b (last-fired.md); the guaranteed-slot firer never stamps it. So last_fired measures one of two live dispatch paths and understates delivery. Every prior inference that used last_fired as a delivery oracle for a guaranteed slot needs re-checking against the firer log. Note the same field is ALSO an attempt stamp not a delivery record (separate known defect) — it is now wrong in two independent directions.

Firer invocations on 2026-08-13, 08-14 and 08-18 used the bare prompt 'slot=chef-eod' with NO flow path. Today's uses 'run docs/agents/unified-agent/flow/chef.md  slot=chef-eod'. Outcomes on the pathless variant: 08-13 exit_code=143 (SIGTERM at the 1800s bound — consistent with a claude process given no instruction), 08-18 exit_code=1, 08-14 exit_code=0. The 08-14 exit-0 on a prompt that names no flow is a phantom-success candidate: exit 0 does not establish that a chef cycle ran. Prompt variant was corrected somewhere between 08-18 and 08-24; the fix is not attributable from the log alone.

Every guaranteed-slot-firer log line is duplicated from 2026-08-13 through 2026-08-23T13:18:32Z; single-line from 2026-08-23T17:32:36Z onward. Live check: exactly ONE launchd job registered (launchd/com.vn-market.cowork-guaranteed-slot-firer.plist) and exactly one loaded (pid 73052). Both copies share start AND exit timestamps to the second, which favours duplicated log writes over two independent claude processes — but two processes killed by the same 1800s bound would also share an exit second, so the discriminator is not decisive for the 08-13 exit-143 pair. Historical and self-resolved; recorded because incident notes reading that window will double-count every fire.

Producer tick-snapshot.md names by wall clock at write time; consumer emitPressureStateTool.ts:398 looks up by nominal tick. Offsets this session: 08:15 nominal -> 08:20 file (+5), 08:30 -> 08:36 (+6), 08:45 -> 08:52 (+7). Monotone widening across three consecutive ticks, not a fixed skew. The wider the offset, the more often a snapshot lands in the NEXT nominal bucket, which is the path that lets a prior-day same-HH:MM residue satisfy the 4h gate and set stale_warning=true. cycle-snapshot-latest.json unpromoted for the 18th consecutive tick.
emit_pressure_state accepts pressure_mode and docs/data/pressure-state.json still has no pressure_mode key (jq has("pressure_mode") == false). 19th consecutive confirmation.

preflight reported new_signals=0; the immediately-following Step 0a drain routed 2 files and inserted 2 rows (db_count 334 -> 336). Third consecutive reproduction (08:15, 08:30, 08:45). Stable divergence, not noise. 'DB rows since last tick' remains a legitimate reading of the field name, so this is a contract to pin before any consumer gates on it, not yet a defect.

drain-signals.js again SKIPped notebook-prune-dropped-newest-docs-agent-memory-notebooks-dev-mcp-server-md-2026-08-23T152548Z.json (parse error at position 581, line 14) and -2026-08-23T194934Z.json (position 533, line 14). Sixth consecutive skip. Root cause on file: notebook-auto-prune.sh lines 574/575 use 'grep -c ... || echo 0', emitting a bare 0 that breaks the JSON object. Fix is '|| true' plus repair of the two stuck files. Zone scripts/ -> developer.

Step 4b grouped MATCHES by agent_id: unified-agent (chef-eod) and alert-commander (alert-commander-market) are distinct, so no agent appeared in >=2 slots and no WARN fired. Correct by construction. Worth recording that Step 4b would NOT have caught this tick's real collision — its scope is same-agent-across-slots within one MATCHES array, and the chef-eod collision is cross-MECHANISM (firer vs dispatcher), which no guard in this flow observes.
